command:
candidate=/tmp/antrieb-haproxy.cfg
cat > "$candidate" <<'ANTRIEB_HAPROXY_EOF'
global
    log /dev/log local0
    log /dev/log local1 notice
    chroot /var/lib/haproxy
    stats socket /run/haproxy/admin.sock mode 660 level admin expose-fd listeners
    stats timeout 30s
    user haproxy
    group haproxy
    daemon

defaults
    log global
    mode http
    option httplog
    option dontlognull
    timeout connect 3s
    timeout client 30s
    timeout server 30s

frontend http_in
    bind *:80
    default_backend nginx_backends

backend nginx_backends
    balance roundrobin
    option httpchk GET /
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 1s fall 2 rise 2
    server node1 10.100.151.10:5660 check
    server node2 10.100.151.11:5660 check
    server node3 10.100.151.12:5660 check
ANTRIEB_HAPROXY_EOF
haproxy -c -f "$candidate" || exit 1
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
  if [ ! -e /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.antrieb-before ]; then
    cp -a /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.antrieb-before
  fi
  install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$candidate" /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
  systemctl enable haproxy
  systemctl restart haproxy
else
  if ! sudo -n test -e /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.antrieb-before; then
    sudo -n cp -a /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.antrieb-before
  fi
  sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$candidate" /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
  sudo -n systemctl enable haproxy
  sudo -n systemctl restart haproxy
fi
printf 'active='
systemctl is-active haproxy
printf 'enabled='
systemctl is-enabled haproxy
ss -tlnp | awk 'NR == 1 || $4 ~ /:80$/'
printf 'first_response='
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "http://$NODE_IP/"

cat > "$candidate" <<'ANTRIEB_HAPROXY_EOF'
global
    log /dev/log local0
    log /dev/log local1 notice
    chroot /var/lib/haproxy
    stats socket /run/haproxy/admin.sock mode 660 level admin expose-fd listeners
    stats timeout 30s
    user haproxy
    group haproxy
    daemon

defaults
    log global
    mode http
    option httplog
    option dontlognull
    timeout connect 3s
    timeout client 30s
    timeout server 30s

frontend http_in
    bind *:80
    default_backend nginx_backends

backend nginx_backends
    balance roundrobin
    option httpchk GET /
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 1s fall 2 rise 2
    server node1 10.100.151.10:5660 check
    server node2 10.100.151.11:5660 check
    server node3 10.100.151.12:5660 check
ANTRIEB_HAPROXY_EOF
haproxy -c -f "$candidate" || exit 1
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
  if [ ! -e /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.antrieb-before ]; then
    cp -a /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.antrieb-before
  fi
  install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$candidate" /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
  systemctl enable haproxy
  systemctl restart haproxy
else
  if ! sudo -n test -e /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.antrieb-before; then
    sudo -n cp -a /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.antrieb-before
  fi
  sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$candidate" /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
  sudo -n systemctl enable haproxy
  sudo -n systemctl restart haproxy
fi
printf 'active='
systemctl is-active haproxy
printf 'enabled='
systemctl is-enabled haproxy
ss -tlnp | awk 'NR == 1 || $4 ~ /:80$/'
printf 'first_response='
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "http://$NODE_IP/"
